title: Navigation and Screen Architecture

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Navigation and Screen Architecture** as part of **Kotlin for Android Development**. Android application code must respect lifecycle, UI-thread rules, accessibility, permission boundaries, and the compatibility of Android/Compose dependencies. Use the subtopics—Multi-Screen Applications, Passing Arguments Between Destinations, Back Navigation—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Android code must account for lifecycle changes, accessibility, UI state, and platform APIs. Isolating business logic makes the interface easier to test.
